final_message:
`slugify("  Hello -- World! ")` now returns `"hello-world"`, and all 3 tests pass under `node --test`.

The bug was in `slug.mjs`, where each non-alphanumeric character became its own dash. I changed the replace to treat a whole run of such characters as one separator (`/[^a-z0-9]+/g`). I then added a second replace that strips any leading or trailing dash.

I also added a regression test for your example input in `slug.test.mjs`.
